ops-bot: Created tickets: INFRA-940 (quota), INFRA-941 (scheduler), INFRA-942 (runbook), INFRA-943 (telemetry). Recurring "GPU follow-ups" 4w Wednesdays 09:30 UTC.

marta: Quota ETA Fri 18:00 UTC. Posting justification: "Sustained bursts exceeded reserved pool; requesting temporary soft quota to restore target headroom while autoscaler and scheduler fixes deploy."

jordan: Canary ETA Tue COB; will attach smoke test and cost delta. Rollback if p95 > baseline*1.12 or queue depth +25.
